title: xmltoexcel action
description: Converts an XML body into an xlsx workbook: each child of the root is a row, each of its children a cell, as xmltocsv does for CSV. Numbers become numeric cells, all else text.

includeHeader.title: Include header
includeHeader.description: Start with a row of column names

includeIndexColumn.title: Include index column
includeIndexColumn.description: Start every row with its number (1, 2, ...)

orderHeaders.title: Order headers
orderHeaders.description: Columns in the order they first appear (unordered) or alphabetically (ordered)

useCustomWorksheets.title: Custom worksheets
useCustomWorksheets.description: Make a worksheet of each entry of worksheets instead of one worksheet of the root's children

worksheets.title: Worksheets
worksheets.description: JSON list of {"name": "Sheet", "xPathExpression": "/a/b"}, optionally as RAW(<base64>); the rows of a worksheet are the elements the path selects, the root's children if it is empty. Used only with useCustomWorksheets
